name: X1 carbine
description: The X1 carbine was a disruptor carbine weapon produced by the Wookiees. A variant of this weapon called the Malevolent bowcaster also existed. Non-Wookiee spacers were known to obtain modified versions of the weapon from the Avatar Orbital Platform. This weapon was used during the Battle of Kashyyyk to defend the tree-city of Kachirho.
